correctness.rationale: Trace coefficient b(fg)=b(f)+b(g) and constant c(fg)=c(f)c(g) yield two-character Euler products. Unique factorization f=gh^2 gives S_{psi,chi}(u)=Z_{psi,chi}(u)/Z_{psi^2,chi^2}(u^2). In characteristic 2 additive psi^2 is trivial and nontrivial chi^2 remains nontrivial (q-1 odd); for n>=2 their terms vanish. Inverse Fourier transform gives exact two formulas independent of nonzero constant and treats n=2 where t=0 produces 0. Independently enumerated GF(2) monic-polynomial fibers n=2..8 with derivative-gcd squarefreeness, all 14 trace/constant fibers matching. Infinite result is the formal power-series argument.
residual_risks: Finite independent calculations do not establish untested infinite cases; unrestricted conclusions rest on proof lemmas.

evidence: Kuttner–Wang general factorization-pattern enumeration prescribes leading coefficients, not this mixed leading-and-constant pair without further derivation. Oppenheim–Shusterman concerns existence for large fields. Gao–Kuttner–Wang title/abstract includes related objects but full text unavailable.

Sharp characteristic-two uniformity and nonemptiness boundary are information not contained in the unrestricted total.

final_claim: For q=2^r,n>=2, c!=0, monic squarefree f of degree n with second-leading coefficient t and constant c has N=(q^(n-1)-q*(-1)^n)/(q+1) if t=0 and (q^(n-1)+(-1)^n)/(q+1) otherwise.
